description: Use this when someone asks to change their practice's website colours, social links, WhatsApp number, external website or online booking window. Returns the settings as saved and which changed; they show on the public site at once. Not for the subdomain, custom domain, logo or banner, which change in the DodoDentist app.

expectedLastEditTime.description: The lastEditTime from get_website_settings. A practice changed since then is refused.

externalWebsiteUrl.description: The practice's own website address; null removes it

facebook.description: Facebook page or profile, as a handle or a link; null removes it

hostedByDododentist.description: True for the website DodoDentist hosts; false when the practice has its own website elsewhere and uses DodoDentist for booking

instagram.description: Instagram profile, as a handle or a link; null removes it

maximumAdvanceBooking.description: How far ahead patients can book online

amount.description: Whole number of units; leave it out with tomorrow

minimumBookingNotice.description: How soon before a slot patients can still book online

primaryColor.description: Main colour as #rrggbb; null goes back to DodoDentist's

secondaryColor.description: Accent colour as #rrggbb; null goes back to DodoDentist's

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number patients can write to, with the country code; null removes it
